# Q3 2026 Operating Brief

## Executive summary

Q3 was a financially solid quarter: revenue of $720,000 against total spend of
$464,000 produced an operating surplus of $256,000, a surplus margin of
roughly 35.6%. Support handled a heavy ticket load (1,250 opened) and closed
93.7% of them. Security kept pace with threat volume, resolving 95.0% of the
80 incidents detected. The active delivery project, kicked off October 5,
is tracking to a launch on 2026-10-23 once all four phases (Discovery, Build,
QA, Release) run their course around the mid-plan company holiday. Three
figures quoted in the source packets' own summary lines do not match the
underlying line-item data (spend total, support close rate, and launch date);
see Notes for the discrepancies and which figures were used below.

## Key figures

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Q3 revenue | $720,000 |
| Q3 spend | $464,000 |
| Operating surplus | $256,000 |
| Support close rate | 93.7% |
| Launch date | 2026-10-23 |
| Security resolution rate | 95.0% |

## Notes

The source packets contained three internal inconsistencies between a
stated "summary" figure and the underlying data. In each case the
underlying itemized data (which can be independently recomputed) was
treated as authoritative and the summary sentence as the error worth
escalating:

- **Finance:** The four spend line items (Payroll $286,400 + Infrastructure
  $81,750 + Contractors $64,200 + Facilities $31,650) sum to $464,000, but
  the finance packet's summary sentence states total Q3 spend as $463,250 —
  a $750 shortfall. Q3 spend and Operating surplus above use the computed
  $464,000 figure; if the packet's $463,250 figure is instead correct,
  Operating surplus would be $256,750.
- **Support:** 1,171 closed / 1,250 opened computes to a 93.7% close rate,
  but the support dashboard sentence states 96.4%. The figure above uses the
  computed 93.7%. Worth confirming which number the dashboard is actually
  reporting off of, since it does not appear to be derivable from the
  opened/closed counts given.
- **Delivery:** Applying the stated phase durations (Discovery 3 + Build 6 +
  QA 4 + Release 1 = 14 inclusive business days, next phase starting the
  next business day, weekends and the 2026-10-12 company holiday excluded)
  to the 2026-10-05 start date computes to a launch date of 2026-10-23. The
  delivery packet's summary sentence instead states 2026-10-22 — that date
  only results if the October 12 company holiday is *not* excluded from the
  count. The figure above uses the computed 2026-10-23 per the stated
  business-day convention; leadership should confirm whether the holiday is
  actually being honored in the working plan, since a one-day slip either
  way affects the committed launch date.

No inconsistency was found in the security packet: 76 resolved / 80 detected
computes to exactly 95.0%, matching the stated figure.
